frequency_question: How often do major superpowers escalate to secondary banking sanctions against peer-competitor financial institutions within a comparable time window of active embargo enforcement?
membership_rule: Includes instances where a dominant financial superpower has an active embargo on a major energy exporter and faces systemic non-compliance from banks in a peer competitor nation, tracked across 24-month rolling windows since 2000. Excludes minor fines or non-punitive warnings.
